xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4198: Trim the issue right-click menu to state-relevant actions (Replan split to #4203, sync-main conflict UX split to #4204)

plan.title: Trim the issue right-click menu to state-relevant actions; add Replan (archive branch + fresh plan from main)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.splitNote: Parts 3 (Replan) and 4 (sync-main conflict UX) of the original request were split into #4203 and #4204 because the full surface exceeded the 25-file / 6-subsystem finalize gate. This plan covers parts 1-2 (menu trim + consolidation).

narratives.Problem: The issue right-click menu (shared grouped body in IssueActionGroupedBody.tsx, driven by ISSUE_ACTIONS in src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/issueActions.ts) renders all 39 registry actions, including disabled ones with a 'gated' count, and repeats phase primaries. It offers seven overlapping ways to retry an agent, five teardown actions, and jargon like 'Watch planning' (a placeholder dialog) and 'Done planning'. 'Auto-plan' names an unregistered endpoint; 'Start without planning' never sends autoStart; 'Upload transcript' is hard-disabled. The operator cannot tell what half of it means.
narratives.Proposal: Reshape the registry: add a placement field (menu | contextual), collapse groups to Communicate / Actions / Inspect / Danger, retire 12 overlapping or dead keys with a widened RETIREMENT_AUDIT, relabel everything in plain language, and add getMenuActions(state). Menus render only enabled menu-placed actions, primaries once under 'Next step', Danger only when non-empty, session extras under a collapsed Debug disclosure. Consolidate retry into a 'Restart agent…' dialog (keep memory → /restart or /recover; fresh session → /restart-fresh {spawn:true}) and planning into one 'Plan…' dialog with a 'Start work as soon as the plan is ready' checkbox (autoStart:true). A per-derived-state unit test pins the exact menu set (≤10) for 10 fixtures. Docs and Playwright screenshots follow. No server, CLI or src/lib changes.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The Replan action, `pan replan`, and archive-before-reset (owned by #4203)
- The sync-main conflict dialog / toast change (owned by #4204)
- Any server route, CLI verb, or src/lib change; retired UI actions' endpoints (/copy-settings, /sync-discussions, /reset-session, /restart-fresh {spawn:false}, /deep-wipe) stay registered
- Deleting `pan wipe` or any CLI verb
- The Zone B session strip (ZoneBActionStrip.tsx, ZONE_B_SESSION_ACTIONS) and its pinned key set
- The hand-built AgentStepRow right-click menu and the ContainerNode menu
- CommandPalette.tsx (does not use the registry)
- A new Start dialog
- Fixing the stale verifying-on-main-badge reference in pan-1190-verify-close-out.spec.ts

autoDecisions.summary: Split the four-part request: menu trim + consolidation stay here; Replan → #4203; sync-main conflict UX → #4204.
autoDecisions.rationale: The full surface is ~30 files across >6 path subsystems, which fails the finalize size gate; each part is independently shippable and the menu budget reserves room for the Replan entry.

autoDecisions.summary: Menus hide gated actions instead of showing them disabled.
autoDecisions.rationale: The acceptance criterion counts visible menu items (≤10); one grouped body serves every menu surface so they stay consistent.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Start without planning' becomes a PlanDialog checkbox sending autoStart:true, not a Start-dialog option.
autoDecisions.rationale: No Start dialog exists (startAgent POSTs directly) and the case only arises for unplanned issues, whose entry point is the Plan dialog; the old action never sent autoStart at all.

autoDecisions.summary: Restart dialog offers two options (keep memory / fresh session), not three.
autoDecisions.rationale: restartFromPlan (POST /api/agents) and restart-fresh {spawn:true} produce the same new run on the same branch; the latter also clears stale agent state.

autoDecisions.summary: Keys with live card consumers (pause, recoverAgent, rebuildAndStart, createWorkspace) become placement:'contextual' instead of being retired.
autoDecisions.rationale: NeedsYouSlot, AgentActivityCards, spotlight, AgentsLane, WorkspaceCard and the agent-scope menu invoke them by key; retiring them would break those surfaces.

autoDecisions.summary: Wipe is removed from the issue menu; Reset to Todo is its successor.
autoDecisions.rationale: deepWipeIssue runs the same runDestructiveIssueLifecycle(id,'reset') teardown plus an archive-row flag; `pan wipe` stays in the CLI.

autoDecisions.summary: RETIREMENT_AUDIT rows may name a newHome file or a dropped reason when no successor key exists.
autoDecisions.rationale: upload, syncDiscussions, copySettings, inference, discussions and transcripts have no registry successor; this mirrors THE-CUT.md's 'new home or dropped (why)' idiom instead of deleting the audit.
It is the existing store action that opens the issue drawer on its live conversation; today's action opens a placeholder frame.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 and the 'Target registry' table exactly. In issueActions.ts: add `placement: 'menu' | 'contextual'` to IssueActionEntry; set IssueActionGroup = 'communicate' | 'lifecycle' | 'inspect' | 'danger', GROUP_LABELS {communicate:'Communicate', lifecycle:'Actions', inspect:'Inspect', danger:'Danger'}, GROUP_ORDER ['communicate','lifecycle','inspect','danger']; remove the 12 D6 keys (autoPlan, startSkipPlanning, restartFromPlan, completeWorkReset, resetSession, wipe, inference, discussions, transcripts, upload, syncDiscussions, copySettings) from IssueActionKey and ISSUE_ACTION_DEFINITIONS; apply every label/description/group/kind/placement from the table (pause, recoverAgent, rebuildAndStart, createWorkspace are 'contextual'; restartAgent kind 'dialog'; watchPlanning kind 'safe'); add predicates canResumeWork, canRestartAgent, canSyncMain, canResetIssue, canDestroyWorkspace (= hasWorkspace && isDoneOrCanceled — the server's cleanup-workspace route 409s unless the tracker issue is closed/done), tightened canAddToOrderBook and requestReview per the PRD snippet; replace PHASE_PRIMARY_KEYS with the PRD map; add `export function getMenuActions(state)`; delete canStartWithoutPlanning and the orphaned 'Complete review reset' comment. In useIssueActions.ts: drop retired keys from dialogActionKeys, artifactTabs (keep tasks), bodyForAction, destructiveMessage; add restartAgent to dialogActionKeys; in runAction dispatch watchPlanning as `openIssue(issueId, 'conversation')` and return. In IssueActionMenu.tsx: PlanDialog branch condition becomes `activeDialog.key === 'plan'` and drop the autoStart prop. Update inventory.ts actionRelocation rows naming retired keys. Update the five test files per PRD WI-1 step 6, including widening RETIREMENT_AUDIT to allow `newHome` (existing file) or `dropped` (reason) and adding the 12 rows; DESTRUCTIVE_ACTION_KEYS becomes ['closeOut','resetIssue','destroyWorkspace','cancel']. If a predicate disagrees with the PRD's 'Expected menu per derived state' table, the table wins.
